productBrief:
Feature: Inventory Desk — Product Requirements Document
Small warehouse teams currently manage stock levels in disconnected spreadsheets, causing stale data and a general lack of trust in the numbers. Sales and restocks are recorded in multiple places, making it impossible for the shop manager to get a reliable picture of on-hand stock or identify items running critically low before a stockout occurs. The Inventory Desk is a lightweight, role-aware REST API (with Swagger UI for demo use) that gives the shop manager a single authoritative catalog and gives warehouse staff a controlled way to log every stock movement.
